tables: 38 random 4-sphere tables (makeTables 4242, every compatible pair at least twice), dealt round-robin

rows.name: Banker
rows.why: Banker ("Now and at round start, +3 gold"; 4, repriced to 8 in balance pass 1; the range is absolute). By arithmetic +9/+6/+3 gold by round recruited, ~7 averaged, plus a follower; the Normal sweep read 7.3 [6.3–8.3] recruited in round I.

rows.name: Big Family
rows.why: Big Family (4: "Worth 3 followers", no ability), the plain worth-N member: 3 followers ≈ 4 resources at 4→3, less the follower buy it displaces. The Normal sweep read 2.4 [0.6–3.6].

rows.name: Sponsor
rows.why: Sponsor (10: "Your members cost 2 less"), rework-candidates #1, known strong: must read 8 or more (printed − 2).

rows.name: Tycoon
rows.why: Tycoon ("Game end: +1 follower per 3 gold"), rework-candidates #3, known weak at its old 12: must read 10 or less (absolute; repriced to 6 in balance pass 1, so it no longer has to read under printed).
